dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent structures exhibit irregular 'O' and 'C' geometries with jagged, high-contrast perimeters. There is a steep intensity gradient transitioning from the low-value dark-grey exterior surface to the high-value white band that defines the ring perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels without internal gradients are scattered across the dorsal surface, with a higher spatial frequency and core pixel concentration observed near the right lateral margin of the posterior torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the upper posterior flank form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral. Smaller high-intensity blobs are distributed in an approximately linear arrangement between the two most dorsal-medial macro-annuli.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal ridges and deep folds are visible on the dorsal surface of the hind flippers, creating a high-relief textured appearance distinct from the spotted dorsal-lateral patterning.
